data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 169.218m. During 2024 there was an adverse movement in prior year estimates (gross) of GBP 5.651m (strengthening of reserves), recorded as "Change in estimates of prior year provisions". Management commentary indicates consideration of heightened economic inflation and social inflation / litigation trends when setting reserving assumptions, which contributed to the reserve strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions 5,651 (248) 5,403
Management has considered the effects of the continued heightened inflation environment on claims reserves and has made appropriate allowance in the reserve results.
Specific considerations were made around current economic circumstances, social inflation trends and the potential impact to business portfolio mix when setting reserving assumptions.
